preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
The length of each string A and B is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The strings A and B have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: A and B contain only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B consist of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.expression: output is -1 if conversion is impossible
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to convert string A to string B, the output should be -1.

postconditions.expression: output contains the minimum number of operations
postconditions.description: If conversion is possible, the output should include the minimum number of operations required to convert A to B.

postconditions.expression: output includes the operations to convert A to B
postconditions.description: If conversion is possible, the output should include the specific operations that convert A to B.

invariants.expression: T is the number of test cases
invariants.description: The number of test cases T is a fixed value that does not change during the execution of the program.

invariants.expression: N is the length of strings A and B
invariants.description: The length of strings A and B is the same for each test case and is denoted by N.

invariants.expression: A and B are strings of lowercase English letters
invariants.description: Both strings A and B consist of lowercase English letters only.
